spanish: Toma de parte de ellos, y serán a servir el servicio de tienda de reunión, y darás a ellos a los levitas, varón conforme a boca de su servicio.

findings.issue: «de parte de» adds parte/behalf (or side). The token is only from-with them.
«el» makes the construct chain definite; עבדת אהל מועד has no article.

notes: Take, be-to-serve, give them to the Levites, and man according to the mouth of his service match the remaining tokens.
